Hand-off notes at first light brought a blocked lane

Blocked Lane Delay Report

The first-light hand-off noted a blocked lane at the cargo side, and that slowed the normal transfer path for pet carriers at Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk was notified right away, and the ground team held all movement until the route was checked and cleared. Amara Tanaka and Sadie were already in the care flow, so we kept the tone calm and gave the traveler a simple update while the cabin team confirmed the animal was settled and comfortable.

Once the lane was open, the ground team moved the carrier by hand with extra care and checked the latch, bedding, and water setup before release. The service desk kept the file moving and noted the delay for follow-up support. <<FACT F115>> The traveler was told the case was logged and that any missed connection review would be handled through the normal service channel. <<FACT F110>> Samuel Andersson also received a brief status note so both travelers had the same clear picture of the recovery steps.

No signs of stress or injury were reported for the pet, and the cabin team said the animal remained calm through the change. The follow-up plan is to keep the lane issue on record, review the transfer path with the station team, and remind staff to call for early help if the route looks blocked again. The report is closed with no further action needed beyond the normal review.
